title: Management of Acute Myocardial Infarction in the Presence of Left Bundle Branch Block
brief_summary: The primary objective of this study is to propose new treatment algorithm (strategy) for patients with Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS) and left bundle-branch block (LBBB).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 - 75 years
* Ischemic discomfort (ie, ischemic chest pain or equivalent) at rest ≥20 minutes within previous 24 hours.
* Any (new, presumably new, or old) LBBB on the prehospital (ambulance) or admission ECG.
* Urgent coronary angiography (followed, when indicated, by PCI), ideally within 90 minutes after admission

Exclusion Criteria:

* all-comers design
